page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon 8163 processor cores running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the CPU performance of the Intel Xeon 8163 on this instance is generally modest. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, alongside Geekbench scores, place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. However, it achieves average performance in Passmark CPU tests, physics simulations, and large-block memory bandwidth reads and writes. Cryptographic and compression tasks show lower efficiency, with single-threaded gzip and bzip3 decompression falling into the bottom 10%.

Given the high memory density relative to compute power, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency CPU performance or local storage. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis (which achieved average performance in SET operations), and basic web serving. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a high volume of RAM per resource unit, though the tradeoff is lower compute throughput per vCPU.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 8 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, running on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz. Utilizing the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 architecture instance provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core, though it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks show a clear tradeoff: while large-block memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations reach average tiers, CPU-heavy tasks, single-core processing, and compression benchmarks fall into the bottom 25% or lower. Consequently, this instance is best suited for memory-intensive workloads with moderate compute demands, such as caching layers, in-memory databases, and basic web serving, offering high memory density at the expense of raw processing speed.
